name: Hikaru
source:
[url=/c95194]Kuzuhara[/url]'s boyfriend.

Belongs to a gang of thugs. He is a prime example of evil who is into money, women and violence. He is considered dangerous even within his own gang due to his lack of mercy.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
